caption:
A semicolon is secretly just a period.

Both sides of a semicolon have to be complete sentences. If one side couldn't end with a period, the semicolon is wrong.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: A semicolon is secretly a period. Both sides must stand alone.

youtube.title: SAT Semicolon Rule: Both Sides Must Be Sentences
youtube.description: A semicolon can only join two complete sentences. Cover each side and ask if it could end with a period.
